gallery.title: Seawater minerals & nitrogen feeding
gallery.caption: Fernando explains feeding the trees with dilute seawater minerals (every mineral that exists) alongside nitrogen to push production.

gallery.title: The melon-note cacao
gallery.caption: “Something surreal — look, full of melon! Like a cantaloupe squashed with something.” The signature flavour of Fazenda Clara.

gallery.title: How top chefs use this cacao
gallery.caption: “The biggest chefs use it like the secret sprinkle of the recipe. We planted almost a hectare of this cacao.”

gallery.title: Tasting on the land
gallery.caption: “It has a special flavour — with 60 notes, something of melon for sure.” Fernando shares the pods straight off the tree.

gallery.title: “Ele é muito delicioso!”
gallery.caption: Tasting Fazenda Clara cacao on site — “it's very delicious, it's very savoury! The question is the sale!”

gallery.title: Blends & chocolate makers
gallery.caption: “They've been using it a lot to make chocolate blends. Let's open them and see how it is.”
